items.name: Continuous-Claude-v3
items.description: Context management for Claude Code. Hooks maintain state via ledgers and handoffs. MCP execution without context pollution. Agent orchestration with isolated context windows.

items.name: waggle
items.description: Attributed, resolvable artifact references for agent handoffs — a ~30-byte token instead of pasted context. MCP-native; the reference layer for the agent-harness world.

items.name: repo-docs-skills
items.description: Living project docs for coding agents: keep guides, progress logs, change maps, and handoff context updated as your repo evolves.

items.name: repo-context-ledger
items.description: 面向 AI 上下文管理的 Agent Skill：为 Codex 上下文管理、Cursor 上下文切换和 Claude 上下文管理提供跨窗口续接，用 Git 保存可验证的功能说明与变更记录。AI coding context management and agent handoffs.

items.name: point
items.description: Git-native context handoff for humans and AI agents

items.name: catchup
items.description: Local-first CLI for coding-agent context handoff. Transfer and resume sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Kimi, Antigravity, OpenCode, and Pi Agent.

items.name: hermes-warm-compaction
items.description: Hermes Agent context engine: the main model writes the compaction handoff on its cached prompt prefix

items.name: OrbitRelay
items.description: Multi-Agent Handoff Inspector: analyze multi-agent handoff records, score context completeness, surface coordination bottlenecks, and render a review dossier.

items.name: project-os-for-codex
items.description: Open-source control plane for Codex projects: Git-backed context, visible agent progress, scoped MCP access, resumable work, and safe handoffs.

items.name: portable-handoff
items.description: Maintain the same context between AI chats, models, and coding agents.  Stop re-explaining your project every time you switch AI tools.

items.name: hermes-relay-for-chrome
items.description: Hermes Relay for Chrome gives Hermes Agent a direct browser surface for page context, capture, watchlists, and AI handoff.

items.name: valcraft
items.description: Agent skills for spec-driven development. An automated agentic delivery loop coordinates planning, implementation, and cross-agent code reviews. Requirements, plans, and decisions live in ordinary project files with project-wide IDs linked from commits and PRs, reducing manual handoffs and repeated explanations while keeping session context small.

items.name: handoff
items.description: Handoff context from one agent to another agent

items.name: sctxx
items.description: sctxx — coding agent Session Context Extractor. standalone, agent-agnostic CLI (plus a thin Agent Skill wrapper) that reads a coding-agent session transcript from disk — Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Pi — and produces a compact, verified, provenance-linked handoff artifact that any other coding agent can load to continue the work. LLM-anchored fold.

items.name: context-diamond
items.description: Auditable context capsules for LLM handoffs, coding agents, and OpenCode MCP workflows.

items.name: agent-handoff
items.description: Context transfer protocol for multi-agent systems - clean handoffs between AI agents with schema validation, state serialization, and chain tracking

items.name: agent-handoff-kit
items.description: Session 接力棒：以 context engineering（為 AI 準備它需要知道的背景資料）為核心，把進度、 決策和下一步留在專案資料夾，讓不同的 AI 工具接手繼續工作。Your session relay baton — context engineering at its core: keep progress, decisions and next steps in your project folder, so supported AI tools can pick up where the last one left off.

items.name: rubi
items.description: Knowledge graph and context manager for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot and local models. Code map with PageRank, temporal knowledge graph, hybrid search, early compaction with handoffs.

items.name: context-handoff-engine
items.description: Persistent context for Claude Code across sessions, terminals, and agents. The infrastructure layer behind recursive-drift.

items.name: agent-workbench
items.description: One local UI for the Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Antigravity CLIs: tabs, browsable history, conversations as cards, handoff between CLIs, global search, context meter, git and file tree. Never touches your credentials.

items.name: ctx-switch
items.description: Switch coding agents without losing context. Generate handoff prompts across Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

items.name: consistorium
items.description: Local-first MCP server: give ChatGPT & friends grounded, current context on the repos your coding agents work in. Live git, docs, tasks, agent handoffs.

items.name: the-vault
items.description: Local-first AI memory system for coding agents: desktop app, CLI, and MCP server for durable project context, handoffs, recall, and task continuity.

items.name: agent-office
items.description: Desktop command center for AI coding agents: shared project memory, a context engine, a local MCP server and handoffs across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Copilot, shown as a live 3D virtual office.

items.name: hol-cigar
items.description: Open-source context engineering protocol for AI agents: governed retrieval, bounded multi-agent handoffs, MCP, provenance, recoverable effects, and replay.
